subject: Decision velocity: economic vs compliance path
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@novushealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Decision velocity: economic vs compliance path

Hi Emma — great conversation this morning, thanks for the time. Quick post-demo recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on timeline and owners:

1) Top decision signals we heard
- Primary economic buyer: Diane Park (CFO) — pricing sensitivity around per-token unit economics and predictable committed capacity.
- Security/compliance stakeholders: Liam O'Connor (legal) + internal security team — DPA and data residency are gating items for pilot.
- Procurement: procurement@novushealth.com will own PO and billing cadence.

2) Suggested sequencing (to minimize cycle time)
- NDA (mutual) to unblock demo artifact sharing and early data exchange — target 1–2 business days for signature.
- Proof-of-concept (pilot) + MAP (mutual action plan) runs in parallel with NDA execution.
- DPA + MSA redlines next — target initial redline turn of 5–7 business days, final MSA 10–14 business days depending on comments.

3) Immediate asks / next steps
- Emma: can you confirm the best legal contact and preferred intake channel (email vs portal)?
- Emma: estimate for how quickly procurement can issue a PO once we have pricing committed (days/weeks).
- Novus: please confirm whether a vendor security questionnaire (or SOC 2 evidence) is required prior to pilot.
- From our side: we will share
  * demo recording (attached)
  * mutual action plan (attached)
  * a short redline checklist for legal to speed review

Attachments (stubs): demo-recording-20261121.mp4, MAP-Novus-20261121.xlsx

I'll follow up with a short MAP and proposed NDA to start the legal thread. Thanks again — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin

marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Emma Liu <emma@novushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision velocity: economic vs compliance path

Thanks Marcus — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed economic buyer: Diane Park (CFO). I'll loop her in when we have pricing options ready.
- Legal intake: our legal lead is Liam O'Connor (liam.oconnor@novushealth.com). Email is fine; he handles initial NDA + MSA redlines.
- Procurement: procurement@novushealth.com is the correct intake for PO questions — typical PO lead time after pricing approval is ~2 weeks but can be expedited for pilots.
- Security: we will need a completed vendor security questionnaire and SOC 2 Type II report for final procurement approval; for pilot we can do a limited data set exchange under NDA.

Can you please send the NDA and MAP as separate attachments and flag any terms you expect to be negotiated (pricing commitment period, data residency, subprocessing)?

On timing: if NDA arrives today, Liam has asked to aim for an initial review within 3 business days — he will then coordinate with procurement after the DPA/MSA comments.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Emma

--
Emma Liu
VP Product | Novus Health
emma@novushealth.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Liu <emma@novushealth.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Decision velocity: economic vs compliance path

Emma / Liam — looping you in on our proposed routing to minimize friction. Forwarding the MAP and a brief redline guidance doc.

Proposed legal cadence (internal recommendation):
- NDA (mutual) — send as a one-pager mutual NDA; target 24–48 hours to signature. We will include minimum necessary data residency language for pilot only.
- DPA (data processing) — parallel review with MSA; target initial redline pass: 5 business days.
- MSA (commercial terms) — target finalization 10–14 business days, contingent on limited redlines.

Practical notes:
- To keep the path short, we suggest using our standard pilot addendum (we'll share) that limits exposure for both parties and accelerates procurement.
- For redlines: ask legal to flag only high-priority changes (data residency, indemnity caps, confidentiality carve-outs). We can accept limited redlines to accelerate signature.

Attachments (stubs): redline-guidelines.pdf, MAP-Novus-20261121.xlsx

Jordan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision velocity: economic vs compliance path

Thanks for the clear plan — I can confirm the following from legal: 

- NDA: Please send your mutual NDA (or signable DocuSign link). We will review and aim to return counters within 3 business days.
- DPA/MSA: once NDA is in place and pilot scope confirmed, we will prioritize the DPA review; expect first pass comments in 5 business days.
- Evidence: Liam notes we will need SOC 2 Type II report and a short security questionnaire completed for procurement to issue a PO for production. Pilot can proceed on a restricted dataset under NDA.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/novus/12345

I will ask procurement to confirm PO timelines after they see pricing.
